title: New compliance and administrative tools for ChatGPT Enterprise
summary: Compliance API integrations, SCIM, and GPT controls to support compliance programs, data security, and user access at scale
body: Compliance API integrations, SCIM, and GPT controls to support compliance programs, data security, and user access at scale
summaryZh: OpenAI为ChatGPT Enterprise推出了新的合规与行政管理工具，包括合规API集成、SCIM支持以及更细致的GPT控件，旨在帮助企业大规模满足合规项目、数据安全和用户访问管理的需求。原始信息显示：Compliance API integrations, SCIM, and GPT controls to support compliance programs, data security, and user access at scale。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“New compliance and administrative tools for ChatGPT Enterprise”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI为企业版ChatGPT新增合规与管理工具，有助于推动LLM在企业级场景的安全合规落地。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
